apps.name: Loan Affordability Calculator
apps.shortDescription: Find out what you can really afford. Enter your loan, income and spending, then test nine what-if scenarios, see a ten-year projection and export a detailed PDF report, all private on your device.
apps.detailedDescription:
Know what you can really afford, before you sign

Loan Affordability Calculator turns three simple numbers (what the asset costs, your deposit, and your monthly income and spending) into a clear answer: can I afford this, and how much is left each month? Then it lets you test the plan: what if rates rise, what if I pay extra, what if I borrow less.

It works for a home, a car, a business purchase or any other loan. Everything stays on your device.

How it works

  1. Set up the loan. Enter the asset value and your deposit and the loan amount follows. Set the interest rate, term and how often you repay (monthly, fortnightly or weekly), and add upfront costs such as legal and bank fees. They are added to the loan, so your deposit stays equal to the money you really have.
  2. Add your budget. Record income from any number of sources, everyday expenses by category, and the running costs you expect once you own the asset. Weekly, fortnightly, monthly and yearly amounts are converted for you.
  3. See the answer. A one-line verdict, the money left each month after the repayment, and the repayment as a share of your income, which is the figure lenders look at.
  4. Ask “what if?” Test nine scenarios and see exactly what each one changes.
  5. Look ahead. Ten-year income and expense projections and plain-language insights.
  6. Take it with you. Export a detailed PDF report, including the full year-by-year repayment schedule, to keep, print or share.

Nine what-if scenarios

  • Rate change – see what a rise or fall in the interest rate does to your repayment and total interest.
  • Extra repayment – find out how much time and interest an extra amount each month saves.
  • Loan term – compare 20, 25 and 30 years side by side.
  • Deposit – see what a bigger or smaller deposit means for the repayment.
  • Lump sum – model a bonus or windfall paid onto the loan.
  • Repayment frequency – see what fortnightly or weekly payments save.
  • Offset account – find out what savings in an offset account are worth.
  • Stress test – learn how high rates could climb before the loan stops being affordable.
  • Combined strategy – stack several of the above and see the total effect.

Every figure and every scenario has a plain-language explanation built in, covering what it is, what each number means, and what to watch out for.

Made for everyday use

  • Private by design: your figures are stored on your device only.
  • Make it yours: four themes (Dark, Light, Forest, Warm), eight fonts, four text sizes and your own currency.
  • Fine control: choose how far each − / + tap moves the rate, repayment and other values.
  • You stay in charge: delete your loan, income or expense data at any time.

New to it?

The step-by-step guide takes you from the first launch to the exported PDF, with a picture of every screen and an explanation of what each figure means and how it is worked out.

Read the complete user guide →

Estimates only. This app does not provide financial advice, and your lender's figures may differ. Speak to a qualified adviser before you borrow.

apps.name: Popes of the Cathloic Church
apps.shortDescription: Comprehensive list of Papacy and Popes of the Catholic Church.
apps.detailedDescription:
Discover the lives of all Catholic popes

A rich, searchable app with biographies, images, and history, all in one place! Perfect for history enthusiasts and students.

Explore the Rich History of the Catholic Papacy

The Popes app offers an in-depth exploration of the Catholic Church's papal history, providing a comprehensive, easy-to-navigate collection of all popes throughout the centuries. Organized chronologically, this app enables you to search by name or browse by the century, offering a unique way to learn about the Church’s remarkable legacy through its leaders.

Each entry provides an extensive profile, detailing not only the essential dates and milestones of each pope’s papacy but also insightful narratives about their lives, contributions, and challenges. Dive into the lives of historical figures, from the early Church martyrs to reformers, scholars, and visionaries who have shaped the Catholic faith across generations.

Features:

  • Detailed Biographies: Each pope’s profile is packed with fascinating details about their journey, major accomplishments, and the historical context of their tenure.
  • Century-by-Century Organization: Discover how the papacy evolved over time, from the ancient world to the modern era, with the option to explore by century.
  • Powerful Search Functionality: Easily find specific popes by name, making the app ideal for quick reference or in-depth study.
  • Rich Visual Content: Browse through relevant images that enhance each entry, bringing historical settings, artifacts, and notable events to life.
  • Educational and Accessible: Perfect for students, researchers, and anyone with a passion for history or the Catholic Church.

Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of religion, or simply curious about the lives of these influential leaders, the Popes app is a beautifully crafted, informative guide to the rich tapestry of the Catholic papacy. Discover the stories behind the men who have led the Church for nearly two thousand years, and gain a deeper appreciation for their lasting impact on faith, culture, and history.
